title: mcp-server
description: Vantaj uptime monitoring via MCP - manage monitors, heartbeats, incidents, and status pages.
summary: Vantaj uptime monitoring via MCP - manage monitors, heartbeats, incidents, and status pages.
offersHint: Vantaj uptime monitoring via MCP - manage monitors, heartbeats, incidents, and status pages. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.vantaj.co/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_projects
toolsPreview.description: List all projects in the workspace. Call this first - most other tools need a project_id.

toolsPreview.name: list_monitors
toolsPreview.description: List uptime monitors in a project, with current status, response time, and 24h uptime.

toolsPreview.name: get_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Get a single monitor by ID, including status, uptime, regions, and settings.

toolsPreview.name: create_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Create a new uptime monitor. Checks start immediately. Types: http, tcp (host:port URL), smtp, ping, ssl, dns. Set inverted=true for exposure monitoring (alert when a target that should stay down becomes reachable).

toolsPreview.name: update_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Update a monitor's settings (name, url, interval, inverted, …). Cannot delete.

toolsPreview.name: pause_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Pause a monitor - checks stop until it's resumed. Use before planned work on a single target.

toolsPreview.name: resume_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Resume a paused monitor - checks start again immediately.

toolsPreview.name: create_maintenance_window
toolsPreview.description: Schedule a one-time maintenance window: the listed monitors keep running but their alerts are suppressed between starts_at and ends_at. Use before deploys or planned downtime.

toolsPreview.name: list_heartbeats
toolsPreview.description: List heartbeat (cron/background job) monitors in a project, with last-ping status.

toolsPreview.name: list_incidents
toolsPreview.description: List incidents (outages) in a project - open and resolved, with timestamps and duration.

toolsPreview.name: get_incident
toolsPreview.description: Get a single incident by ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_domains
toolsPreview.description: List tracked domains with expiry dates, registrar, and days remaining.

toolsPreview.name: list_status_pages
toolsPreview.description: List status pages with visibility, slug, and public URL.
